 25 Oct 26 Starting line-up announced at Stadium of Light.
 Share facebook 
 x 
 email 
 Leeds United face Sunderland in the Premier League this afternoon and manager Daniel Farke has made three changes to his starting line-up.
 England international James Trafford starts in goal for the fixture, with Jaka Bijol replacing Nico Elvedi and starting alongside Tarik Muharemovic and James Justin. Jayden Bogle and Gabriel Gudmundsson continue on the flanks.
 Captain Ethan Ampadu remains in the midfield linking up with Ao Tanaka, whilst Brenden Aaronson and Harry Wilson both start in place of Anton Stach and Noah Okafor, supporting Dominic Calvert-Lewin in the Leeds United attack.
 The substitutes bench features goalkeeper Michael Zetterer, Anton Stach, Noah Okafor, Sean Longstaff, Lukas Nmecha, Jean-Matteo Bahoya, Ilia Gruev, Melvin Bard and youngster Alfie Cresswell.
 Today’s game is scheduled to kick-off at 4.30pm and for those not in attendance at the Stadium of Light, you can listen live on LUTV or follow our live blog.
 Starting XI: Trafford (GK), Bogle, Gudmundsson, Ampadu (C), Muharemovic, Calvert-Lewin, Wilson, Aaronson, Bijol, Tanaka, Justin 
 Substitutes: Zetterer (GK), Longstaff, Nmecha, Stach, Okafor, Bahoya, Bard, Gruev, Cresswell.
